question: Do occupied, denied, missing and removed microphones leave audio muted with resources released, and can the user restart afterwards?

cases.name: occupied
cases.intent: Another application already holds the microphone.
cases.message: Microphone stopped and both routes muted: Injected NotReadableError

cases.name: denied
cases.message: Microphone stopped and both routes muted: Injected NotAllowedError

cases.name: missing
cases.message: Microphone stopped and both routes muted: Injected NotFoundError

cases.name: removed-mid-session
cases.intent: The microphone is unplugged while live.
cases.message: Microphone stopped and both routes muted: Failed to execute 'createMediaStreamSource' on 'AudioContext': parameter 1 is not of type 'MediaStream'.

limits: Injected DOMExceptions and a synthetic track end, not a physical device: no real microphone, speaker or OBS is involved.
Verifies muted state and resource release, not audio quality, latency or sync.
Model-load and backend-loss failures are covered separately by the Python studio tests, not repeated here.
One attempt per state on one host; flapping or repeated-failure behaviour is not covered.
